import java.util.Scanner;

public class E {
    static long mod = 998244353;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner in = new Scanner(System.in);
        long n = in.nextInt();
        long m = in.nextInt();
        long L = in.nextInt();
        long R = in.nextInt();
        
        long totalValues = R - L + 1;
        long evenCount = totalValues / 2;
        long oddCount = totalValues - evenCount;
        
        if ((L % 2) == 1) {
            oddCount = evenCount + 1;
            evenCount = totalValues - oddCount;
        }
        
        long cells = n * m;
        
        if ((n * m) % 2 == 0) {
            long result = (pow(evenCount + oddCount, cells) + pow(evenCount - oddCount, cells)) % mod;
            System.out.println(result);
        } else {
            long result = (pow(evenCount + oddCount, cells) - pow(evenCount - oddCount, cells)) % mod;
            if (result < 0) result += mod;
            System.out.println(result);
        }
    }

    private static long pow(long base, long exp) {
        base %= mod;
        if (base < 0) base += mod;
        long result = 1;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * base) % mod;
            }
            base = (base * base) % mod;
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }
}
